content:
STAGE: design-space elimination and selection (no data read; workspace only contains running.json/session.jsonl/stderr.log/opencode.json, and reading said files is permission-denied, so the proposal is specified abstractly in terms the frozen reference already exposes).

GOAL: pick one hyperbolic SID-table metric that (a) satisfies the 5-clause contract, (b) differs from HBAA and from all 13 measured/refuted candidates, (c) uses strictly more information than "one anchor + mean over ten negatives".

WHAT I READ: the task's own measured table and the "WHAT THAT MEANS" paragraph. OBSERVED: every partition-only statistic fails (bucket count -0.065, cover radius -0.146, voronoi margin -0.081, adj R2 +0.156); every contrast statistic on the frozen reference works (HBAA +0.701; its euclid/flat/anchor controls +0.693..+0.694); and plain path likelihood (-0.488) collapses because it is un-normalised against code size. The highest-value unexploited cells of the design space are therefore: (i) query point = Frechet barycentre of the FULL training history (HBAA already does this, so it alone is not enough), (ii) full negative distribution instead of a mean of ten (partly used by cell_rank_lift +0.344, but at level-1 cells without a query-conditioned posterior), (iii) a closed-form size-matched null (explicitly demanded: "any likelihood-like metric must be contrasted against a size-matched null").

REASONING / CHOICE: I keep the two working ingredients (history barycentre as query, frozen reference as contrast) but change the readout from a linear Gromov-product margin to a normalised posterior mass. Work in the LORENTZ hyperboloid (contract names Lorentz explicitly), logits = Minkowski inner product = -cosh(d), softmax over ALL level-1 cells at the reference's own frozen temperature, and score = mean log( p(c+|q) / pi_{c+} ), i.e. a pointwise-mutual-information between reference geometry and the code, whose pi_{c+} denominator is exactly the size-matched null. This makes collapse structurally unrewarding rather than merely penalised: a 2-cell perfect split can score at most log 2 = 0.693 while a 256-cell perfect split scores log 256 = 5.545, so resolution is valued and no extra capacity factor or second number is needed.

STILL OPEN: none for the proposal itself; the empirical test on the 97 pairs is what the evaluator does. Recorded the full answer as the next record.

FINAL ANSWER (condensed record; the full block is printed in the reply).

METRIC: lorentz_pmi_l1
TITLE: Lorentz-hyperboloid posterior-mass lift of the level-1 cell above its training prior (curvature-exact PMI between frozen reference and code).
FORMULA: kappa=1, nothing fitted. y_i=tanh(tau||x_i||)x_i/||x_i|| (exp_0 of unit Poincare ball); lift p_i=((1+||y||^2)/(1-||y||^2), 2y/(1-||y||^2)). Minkowski <a,b>_L=-a0b0+sum a_k b_k, so <p_i,p_j>_L=-cosh(d_H). mu_q = Lorentz/Karcher barycentre (30 iters of m<-exp_m mean log_m) of {p_h: h in H_q}, H_q = full training history of query q. gamma_c, pi_c = barycentre and training share of level-1 cell c. logit l_qc=<mu_q,gamma_c>_L/T with T=tau (reference's frozen temperature; T=artanh(R) if only ball radius R stored). p(c|q)=pi_c exp(l_qc/T)/sum_c' pi_c' exp(l_qc'/T). m_q = log p(c1(q)|q) - log pi_{c1(q)} = l_+/T - logsumexp_c(log pi_c + l_qc/T). M = mean over training queries with |H_q|>=1 of m_q; higher better; K+<=1 => M=0.
INPUTS: SID table (level-1 codes only), frozen Issue #126 reference (per-item source reps x_i, temperature tau), TRAINING split pairs. Nothing else.
GEOMETRY: unit-curvature Lorentz hyperboloid; curvature enters via exp_0 lift, via <.,.>_L=-cosh(d_H) as the only logit source, and via geodesic Frechet barycentres; cosh growth gives exponential tail suppression with no tuned sharpness.
WHY IT TRACKS: keeps the one working mechanism (frozen reference as contrast) and adds the two discarded informations: query = barycentre of the FULL history (not one anchor), and negatives via a full temperatured posterior over ALL K+ cells (not a mean of ten). The pi denominator is a closed-form size-matched null, so max score is mean log(1/pi) = log2 for a balanced 2-cell table vs log256 for 256 cells: collapse is structurally unprofitable and resolution is rewarded with no second number. Over HBAA (a linear 4-distance margin, unbounded, scale-sensitive): curvature-exact saturation, whole-population negatives, bounded above.
COMPUTE: d~64, K<=256, N=24587, |Q|<=24587; lift+30-iteration barycentres ~5e7 flops; logit matrix 4e8 flops; 25 MB peak; seconds on one CPU core.
RISKS: tau mis-scaling (main fragility; take verbatim, never fit); level-1 only by design; sparse histories dilute toward 0; tiny cells give unstable gamma_c (kept, no size threshold to avoid a tuned parameter); an isotropic reference flattens all logits to M~0.
FAILURE MODE: worst on a balanced random relabelling (hash of item id into 256 blocks): all gamma_c near the centre, posterior returns to pi, m_q->0, M~0 with no variance; also M=0 on the one-code table and on any balanced-but-behaviourally-random level-1.
Open: none; the 97-pair test is the evaluator's step.
END METRIC
